clean_statistics_gate_note: The conservative no-Error gate did not pass because of 8 native threshold diagnostics. Native event accounting and the observable stream completeness are recorded separately.
limits: Warning occurrence counts are not distinct affected-event counts or a bound on proposal bias. Native ISR warning suppression below 1 GeV can hide trial-envelope violations. Conditional sampling errors elsewhere do not include this effect. All species/mass/coupling settings must be read from the separate profile audit. Original full observable streams contain only5001 of20000 rows per job due to analyzer closure; use isolated repaired replay for complete full distributions.
method: First counts are native logger counter deltas around actual S-event next() calls, aggregated from complete matching-channel summaries. Full counts come only from complete native error-statistics tables, not from a count of printed warning lines.

native_error_interpretation.limitation: A native threshold-evolution limitation, distinct from the first-stage charm-denominator support guard. Its distribution effect has not been measured.
native_error_interpretation.semantics: Reference checks gluon-mother xfISR at xDaughter and m2Threshold against TINYPDF, logs this message and returns without storing a candidate. Caller resets dipole pT2=0 before evolution and continues other dipoles. Runtime event counts independently prove no whole-event failure/drop/external retry.

original_analysis_stream_failure.cause: Analyzer PYAEND closes stream97 at each native checkpoint. Later implicit unit97 reopening overwrites fort.97, losing intermediate records. Physics shower/native logs and full HwU remain separate.
original_analysis_stream_failure.fix_owner: Analysis agent owns diagnostic-only fix and isolated identical-seed continuation replay, with all original HwU byte comparisons required.

uncancelled_matching_interpretation: Native threshold diagnostics occur during continuation and do not alter first-stage S/H matching decisions or weights. They can change individual radiator continuation and therefore limit a strict interpretation of full-shower cancellation. Native warning occurrence counts alone do not quantify or bound this distribution effect or proposal-envelope bias.
warning_policy: Native warnings are retained. No warning-based event removal, retry or reseeding is performed.
